en: Hi and welcome to this course. My name is
Maximilian Schwarzmüller. I'll be your
instructor in this course.
And this course, of course, is about Bun, an
amazing JavaScript runtime, a great
alternative to Node.js, a replacement to
Node.js if you want to put it like this,
with better performance, but not just with
that. Though that alone would be a pretty
good reason to use Bun, of course, but Bun
comes with many amazing features built in,
as you will learn over the next lectures and
throughout this entire course, Features that
allow you to get rid of libraries or
packages you may need to use otherwise,
features that may then even be quicker than
if you were using other libraries, and
features that overall, as you will see in
this course, make building both web
applications but also utility tools or CLIs
a breeze.
And therefore, without further ado, let's
dive in and let's see what exactly Bun has
to offer.
